source_contract.terminal: The current virtual-0 terminal and canonical retirement dependencies must not throw. Successful retirement removes the same canonical binding.
source_contract.exception_cleanup: If a zero child cannot be resolved, the source path still performs pointer-array resize/free and base destruction, skips scalar owner free, retains the already-zero child for caller repair, and rejects replay until diagnostic acknowledgement.
source_contract.array_state: Destruction rereads current data and count after child terminals. Normal cleanup leaves data and capacity stale after freeing the current array, matching the recovered native behavior.
source_contract.operation: The lifetime operation is one-shot. A failed operation terminates if abandoned before the caller resolves retained ownership and acknowledges diagnostic cleanup.
